name: Rapid stored-value or wallet hops then cash-out
description: Stored value or funds move quickly between wallets or cards and are then cashed out.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Money or Value Transfer Services (2016)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Prepaid Cards, Mobile Payments and Internet-Based Payment Services (2013)
FATF, Recommendation 16 and Interpretive Note on payment transparency
FATF, Opportunities and Challenges of New Technologies for AML/CFT (2021)

links.name: Rapid wallet-to-wallet hops then cash-out at agent
links.ctx: Value passes through several mobile wallets within hours before cash-out.

links.name: Rapid transfers of stored value between wallets then cash-out
links.ctx: Funds hop across stored-value accounts to peer wallets, then to cash or crypto.
